newsitem.title: CANADA: Xillix, Olympus in marketing deal.
newsitem.headline: Xillix, Olympus in marketing deal.

text.p: Xillix Technologies Corp said on Monday that it signed an exclusive agreement with Olympus Optical Co Ltd of Japan to sell the Xillix LIFE lung endoscopy system in all major markets in North America, Europe and Asia.
Olympus intends to launch sale of the product in early 1997 and placed an order for 10 of the devices, which are used to detect lung cancer using fluorescence.

Xillix said it expected revenues to increase as the Olympus sales force gained experience with the technology. The deal would also pave the way for future applications such as the LIFE-GI system, Xillix said.
Under the deal, Olympus will purchase the systems from Xillix at an agreed-upon transfer price, which Xillix did not disclose.
The initial 10 devices ordered by Olympus will be used for demonstration and to train Olympus sales staff.
Olympus will also provide funding for future development of the system.
